items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: We were pretty good tight friends, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah. We were pretty good tight friends, you know. Yeah. Jabroe has written some several good numbers and no one has ever tried to do them. I did a couple of them.

Yeah, that's a good one. I wanted to put them in several bands -- his numbers. I never can get with the guys to get the songs to them. You know, I -- I will though eventually. But I think he deserves to get some money for them songs he's written.
